card.name: Absence or rarity statements in label text
card.fires_on: Words inside sentences that say something did not happen or is rare, such as 'not' before 'expected', 'in' or a period after 'no reports of overdosage', and 'been' after 'have' in rare-case reports.

modes.label: No overdose reports
modes.description: The word or period right after 'no reports of overdose/overdosage' in the overdosage section.
modes.example: 10 OVERDOSAGE There have been no reports of overdosage<< in>> the AVEED clinical trials. There

modes.label: Negated or rare effects
modes.description: A linking word in a phrase saying an effect is not expected or is uncommon.
modes.example: This small decrease in excretion of gabapentin by cimetidine is<< not>> expected to be of clinical importance. The

modes.description: The word 'been' after 'have' in postmarketing reports of rare serious events.
